name: io.github.iowarp/ndp-mcp
title: CLIO Ndp
description: National Data Platform (NDP) MCP server for searching and discovering datasets across multiple...

tools.name: list_organizations
tools.description: List organizations available in the National Data Platform.

tools.name: search_datasets
tools.description: Search for datasets in the NDP using term-based or field-specific criteria.

tools.name: get_dataset_details
tools.description: Retrieve detailed metadata for a specific dataset by ID or name.

tools.name: register_dataset
tools.description: Create a new general dataset in NDP. Requires bearer auth.

tools.name: register_kafka_topic
tools.description: Register a Kafka topic as an NDP streaming data source. Requires bearer auth.

tools.name: register_s3_resource
tools.description: Register an S3-hosted file as an NDP resource. Requires bearer auth.

tools.name: register_url_resource
tools.description: Register a URL-addressable resource (CSV / JSON / NetCDF / stream). Requires bearer auth.

tools.name: search_resources
tools.description: Search the NDP resource catalog by name, URL, format, or free-text query.

tools.name: get_jupyter_details
tools.description: Fetch JupyterHub workspace connection details. Requires bearer auth.

tools.name: get_user_info
tools.description: Return the calling user's identity and authorization claims. Requires bearer auth.

tools.name: list_kafka_streams
tools.description: List Kafka streaming data sources in NDP. Free to call on server='local'; optional q/name/limit filters.

tools.name: get_kafka_details
tools.description: Get NDP-EP Kafka broker connection details. Requires bearer auth.

tools.name: get_system_metrics
tools.description: Get NDP-EP system health metrics. Requires bearer auth.

tools.name: register_derived_stream
tools.description: Register a derived Kafka topic that filters an upstream one (EarthScope GNSS UI pattern). Requires bearer auth.

resources.name: available_catalogs
resources.description: List of available NDP dataset catalogs.

prompts.name: explore_datasets
prompts.description: Guided workflow for discovering and exploring scientific datasets.
